title: TumorChain: Interleaved Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Traceable Clinical Tumor Analysis
text: Proposes TumorChain, a multimodal interleaved chain-of-thought reasoning framework for traceable clinical tumor analysis, with a 1.5M CoT-labeled VQA benchmark spanning findings, impressions, and pathology predictions from 3D CT scans.
